hooks.name: Pipeline: lint & test on save
hooks.description: When the Python pipeline changes, format with black, lint with ruff, and run pytest to keep the data contract and snapshot encoder correct.

action.prompt: A Python file in pipeline/ changed. Run `ruff check pipeline/`, `black --check pipeline/`, and `pytest pipeline/`. Report any failures concisely and propose minimal fixes. Pay special attention to the binary snapshot encoder staying byte-compatible with schema/binary-layout.md and the Rust decoder.
